title: Pursuit Expands into One of Canada's Leading Tourism Destinations with Eagle Wing Tours Acquisition
summary: Victoria-based marine wildlife experience enters next chapter of growth with continued local leadership, conservation focus and commitment to regenerative tourism Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. (NYSE: PRSU) today announced it has acquired Eagle Wing Tours, a Victoria, British Columbia-based whale watching and marine wildlife experience, expanding its portfolio into one of Canada's most visited and resilient tourism destinations and advancing its strategy of investing in iconic experiences in markets with strong long-term demand. The acquisition marks Pursuit's entry into the Vancouver Island market, a globally recognized destination known for its marine wildlife, natural beauty, vibrant communities and year-round visitor appeal. Victoria welcomes nearly five million visitors annually, highlighting the strength of the region’s visitor economy.
